SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: The two source binaries themselves are exact: CR375 recomputes 2cfca7e9... and FI-05 recomputes 53f1e04e... from the mounted custodies, matching the receipt. The FI-05 identity claim also holds when read from the document: 4 pages, page 1 headed 'Confidential Case Filing Information Sheet - Non-Domestic Relations', footed 'SJRC (04-23) FI-05', printing the continuation instruction and the Case Types List. What does NOT hold is the recorded characterisation of that list. production-field-map.json states twice (selectionBasis on both FI-05 Case Type Code writes) and build-findings.json states once that the binary 'carries the CIRCUIT row "Expunge Marijuana Criminal/Arrest Records  X#"' on 'pages 3 and 4'. Measured from the bytes: the row is printed on page 4 only, and X# occupies xMin 213.48 to xMax 224.36 - the ASSOCIATE column, whose header spans x 197-244. The CIRCUIT column sits at x 257-284, where the neighbouring row 'Expungement of Crim/Arrest Record' carries XG and where the marijuana row carries no code at all. CR375's own caption is 'IN THE ____ JUDICIAL CIRCUIT, ____ COUNTY, MISSOURI'. A reviewer told the source says CIRCUIT would not check the column that decides which division the case type belongs to.

COMPONENT_SET.detail: Three declared components - primary_filing CR375, cover_sheet FI-05, continuation FI-05 - all present in both fixtures. The second FI-05 is the same binary and the receipt says why: FI-05 prints its own continuation instruction and one sheet holds three parties against this petition's four. FILING_DESTINATION.detail: filing-instructions.md names the clerk of the Missouri circuit court where the conviction was charged or guilt was found, and the memo's destination is the same clerk.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: MO.memo.json track mo-art-xiv-marijuana marks exactly one supporting document requiredBeforeFiling true: 'Certified docket sheet and judgment for each case', obtained from the clerk of the court where the case was charged or the finding of guilt entered, and the memo says it is often the only place a marijuana case's quantity appears. Neither participant-instructions.md nor filing-instructions.md names it. Case-insensitive search of both files returns zero occurrences of 'certified', 'docket' or 'judgment'. filing-instructions.md mentions a certificate of expungement, which is a different document the memo marks conditional and requiredBeforeFiling false. This is the Delaware-shaped regression: a document the memo owes before filing that the participant copy never tells the participant to obtain or submit.

ARTIFACTS.detail: canonical recomputes 9f978890...9eb597e and boundary ba549021...8bb2fdb0b, matching reports/rendered-artifacts.json and the dispatch. Both are 10 pages, 612x792, AcroForm removed (Form: none), and poppler reads both without a single warning.

PAGE_ORDER.detail: The 10-page manifest is reproduced by the bytes: CR375 pp1-2, FI-05 pp1-4, FI-05 additional sheet pp1-4, in that order.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: Three elections are made by the packet rather than the participant. Two are sound: the three record-holding agencies named as Defendant(s), and the not-incarcerated posture taken from a held screening fact. The third, FI-05 Case Type Code X#, is written on the strength of two grounds, and only one of them survives the bytes. The census does record this route as filed 'with FI-05 at case type X#', so the value is not unfounded. But the second recorded ground - that the binary's own Case Types List 'carries the CIRCUIT row' for that description - is false, and it is the ground a reviewer would rely on to decide the code is right for a petition captioned in the judicial circuit. X# is printed in the ASSOCIATE column; the CIRCUIT column carries no code for that row. Repair the recorded basis and put the ASSOCIATE/CIRCUIT question to counsel; approval-request.json already asks counsel to confirm the code is current, which is the right place for it.

REPEATING_ROWS.detail: Conviction rows 1 and 2 are complete in all five cells in both fixtures. Rows 3-9 are wholly blank and every cell is classified REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING with a participantMustSupply sentence; no row is half-filled.

No fee figure is published on this track' and feeWaiver GN10 'Not generated by default on this route'. filing-instructions.md says the held sources establish no filing fee and to ask the clerk. That is consistent with the memo, and no GN10 is generated, as the memo directs.

observedNotScored: 27 of the 33 button widgets are unmarked and carry a pdf-lib synthesised stroked border rather than a source Off appearance, because neither CR375 nor FI-05 ships an /AP /N /Off stream. The copy is loose rather than wrong.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: MD.memo.json track md_pardon_expungement lists three selfHelpStopConditions: the ten-year filing deadline being close or passed, more than one conviction putting the 'only one criminal act' condition in issue, and 'The State's Attorney objects.' The first two are carried into participant-instructions.md. The third is absent: case-insensitive search of participant-instructions.md and filing-instructions.md returns zero occurrences of "State's Attorney". The memo also records that the court serves the State's Attorney and that a 30-day objection period runs, so the participant is given the victim-objection notice from the form but is never told that a prosecutor's objection is a stop-and-get-a-lawyer condition.

FILING_DESTINATION.detail: filing-instructions.md sends the petition to the clerk of the court in the caption unless the case was transferred or appealed, and flags items 4 and 5 as the two answers that decide where it goes. That matches the memo's destination and the form's own printed notes.

It is named as a thing to have and produce, not mentioned in passing. Weaker than it should be in one respect, recorded as an observation: the memo's source for it (Maryland Governor's Office or DPSCS) is not named, so a participant who does not have the document is not told where to get it.

This packet does not state an amount, because no held source establishes one; ask the clerk.' MD.memo.json track md_pardon_expungement records rules.fees as '$30 (CC-DC-CR-072B).' - a held source that does establish the amount, keyed to this exact form - and the delivered petition itself prints 'Filing Fees Are Not Refundable' across the top of page 1.
